title: SwePress
excerpt: The content management system behind swemre.com: workspaces, a block editor, forms and channels.

props.title: Write once, publish to every channel
props.copy: A workspace owns every document, media file, form and channel. A document goes out to a channel as a post, and each website reads only its own channel.

props.text: The editor talks to the admin API with a bearer token. Websites read the public API with a read key, so this site never sees drafts or another channel’s posts. Bodies are stored as blocks, and the same block library draws them in the editor and on the site, so a preview looks like the page.

props.copy: You only write the main content. SwePress turns it into distributions for each channel, keeps the data that comes back, and anything can read it over REST or MCP.

title: swemre-website-api
excerpt: The backend of the websites managed from SwePress: a Spring Boot modular monolith with one PostgreSQL schema per module.

props.title: One backend for every site
props.copy: One account owns any number of workspaces, and every document, media file, collection and channel belongs to exactly one of them.

props.text: The CMS calls the admin API with a bearer token; each website reads only through the public API of its own channel. The business modules keep their data in PostgreSQL, one schema per module, and uploaded files on disk. Everything ships as one Spring Boot application behind Traefik on a single VPS.

facts.label: Sign-in
facts.value: Password or Google, for the owner

props.title: Stack and commands
props.copy: Every check runs locally: one verify build covers Checkstyle and all three test categories.

items.name: Checkstyle
items.note: Fails the build on any violation.

props.title: commands
props.code:
$ docker compose up -d
$ ./mvnw verify
$ ./mvnw test -Dtest.category=unit
$ ./mvnw -pl service -am spring-boot:run

props.title: How a request travels
props.copy: Clients reach Traefik first. The service answers v2 routes after checking the caller’s workspace role, and answers ids of another workspace with 404.
